title: Covered Toilet Paper Holder with Glass Shelf, Wall Mount Solid Brass, Waverly Place Collection Allied Brass
description:
Add a refined, space-saving toilet paper holder to your bath with a covered design and an integrated glass shelf. This wall mount toilet tissue holder is crafted from solid brass and pairs easily with matching Waverly Place pieces for a coordinated look across transitional bathroom hardware.

Highlights:
- Covered toilet paper holder helps protect tissue from moisture and dust
- Glass shelf keeps small items up and dry
- Solid brass construction
- Concealed screw hardware for a clean wall-mounted installation
- Designed to coordinate with the Waverly Place Collection (matching Waverly Place, grooved bathroom hardware)

Specs:
- Collection: Waverly Place
- Style: Traditional
- Material: Brass
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Dimensions: 8.75 in (L) x 6 in (W) x 4.6 in (H); projection 6 in
- Product weight: 5.6 lb
- Included items: Toilet paper holder and all installation hardware
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4 in
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Finish variety: Available in 28 designer finishes, including statement colors like sea foam green, glokzin teal, fire engine red, mediterranean blue, and pink.
